alt.en: Under the plan for ten days in December 2026, the peak-wait line and the "Tickets for this plan" card: 3 days Universal, then 4 days Disney, opened up with each resort's dates, the Park Hopper recommendation and the links to buy.

caption.en: Planned without tickets of your own. "Use these as your tickets" makes the suggestions yours, and the days stay where they are. If you already have some, add them at the very bottom.
